dct_description_sm: Polygon feature class showing the location of secondary suites in the City of Abbotsford. Secondary suites are classified as a portion of a single family home which is established as a separate dwelling unit from the principal part of the house. It is typically a finished basement with kitchen facilities, a separate entrance from the exterior, and has a lockable, fire-rated door between the second set of cooking facilities and remainder of the principal dwelling. Updated as an ongoing process.
